capabilities: tag people on photos with a built-in tagger
link photo tags to notes representing people
render photo galleries in notes via code blocks with grouping options
generate image tiles and previews with libvips to zoom large photos
store tags in a configurable JSON file at the vault root
extras: Requires the libvips system library to generate image tiles; the manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
intentEvidence: I did not find the existing plugin, so I decided to write my own.
motivation: The author works with genealogy data in Obsidian and "needed a simple software to tag people on photos and then show a person's photos on their page" but found no existing plugin.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to tag people within photos or to show all photos a person appears in on their note.

relations.evidence: Integration tests run in a real, isolated Obsidian instance using obsidian-integration-testing.

summary: Photo tagging plugin that lets users tag people on photos and render interactive photo galleries inside notes.
